Signing in with the supplied Employee credentials opened the authenticated portal for Emily Dawson.
Dashboard welcomes Emily Dawson, shows pending leave requests 0, and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, and Log out.
Opening My Leave displayed the Employee leave page.
My Leave reached the My leave page.
Opening Timesheet displayed the Employee timesheet for the week of Sep 14, 2026.
Opening My Profile displayed the Employee profile page.
My leave offers New request, shows an available balance of 18 days, and lists an approved Vacation request for Aug 18-19, 2026 with manager comment Approved - enjoy!.
Opening New request displayed the leave-request form.
New request reached New leave request.
The form has Leave type with Vacation, Sick, and Personal options; required Start date and End date fields; Reason; Submit request; and Cancel.
Vacation is selected and the leave-request form is ready for a one-day evaluation request on 2026-10-05.
Submitting after entering the evaluation reason displayed Please fill in all required fields and stayed on New leave request; the date fields remained empty in the observed page.
Timesheet shows a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven daily hour inputs at 0, total 0 h, Save draft, and Submit week.
My profile offers Upload photo, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled read-only Email field, and Save changes.
